context_semantics: With and async-with assign __enter__/__aenter__ result, not the context manager. Builtin dict/set/list managers in these exact7sources have neither method. No legitimate target type is lost: no target value exists. This is an unknown-result inference correction, not a blanket rule suppression whenever any runtime error exists.
closed_iobase: Only existing resolved io-base-initializer evidence permits the IO consumer to use standard IOBase enter-returns-self contract. Unknown custom/self/different managers stay uninferred. Actual existing IO positives and valid different-result controls are replayed.
typed_contract: Annotations are static declared-type evidence, not guaranteed runtime argument types. Eager dict annotation object does not change after a later name rebind; ordinary function-body or value-parameter names do not redefine the annotation namespace. Actual dictionary argument controls exercise deletion. Dict literals/constructors establish instance values independently of the builtin spelling at later use. Function return annotation does not make the function itself a dictionary.

primary_basis.basis: Result of enter is assigned to target; async-with analogously awaits aenter.
Standard IOBase context management returns its stream, unlike arbitrary managers.
Annotations use appropriate definition/runtime namespaces; they do not enforce argument types.
Function definition creates a function object; its return annotation is metadata, not its own object type.

versions: Actual CPython3.10.19 and3.13.5 controls retain exact sources and explicit invocation/namespace models. Generic headers execute only on3.13; canonical3.10 unsupported syntax is retained, not waived. Missing context protocol raises AttributeError on3.10 and TypeError on3.13, both explicitly recorded.
scope: Sixteen exact complete reference/intended output multisets only. No unknown candidate relation, skipped accounting, unrelated diagnostics or fixture body is waived. This generic assignment/protocol contract applies independently of linter IDs.
